topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I just got a surprise in the mail today—a package! At first, I was puzzled because I hadn’t ordered anything. Opening it, I found a lovely old camera inside, along with a note saying it was meant for the former occupant of my apartment. Seems they must have moved without getting it. I’ve always been a bit of a photography enthusiast, so this feels almost serendipitous. I tried it out, and it still works beautifully. Whoever it was meant for, I’m glad it found a home where it can be appreciated. I might just keep it for a while, who knows? Maybe I’ll even try to track down the rightful owner someday. For now, I’m just enjoying the unexpected find.
